newsitem.title: USA: EXAR says Q2 shortfall due to lower revs.
newsitem.headline: EXAR says Q2 shortfall due to lower revs.

text.p: EXAR Corp said Monday its second quarter earnings were hurt by lower revenues, product mix revisions and a $500,000 payment covering an arbitration agreement.
EXAR reported net income of $930,000, $0.10 a share, on sales of $22.7 million compared to net income of $5.4 million, $0.52 a share, on $31.7 million in sales last year.
"Gross margin percentages decreased to 45 percent for the quarter reflecting changes in the product mix as well as the decline in revenue," Ronald Guire, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
